about.techSub: Four powerful technologies combined in one microprocessor-controlled system for comprehensive water conditioning.
about.tech1Text: Ultrasonic waves break down hard water mineral bonds at a molecular level. This first line of treatment initiates the conversion process, disrupting calcium and magnesium compound structures to begin transformation into harmless particles.
about.tech2Text: A permanent magnetic field alters the crystalline structure of calcium carbonate from its hard, scale-forming calcite form into a softer aragonite form that does not adhere to pipe surfaces and equipment.
about.tech3Text: The microprocessor generates variable-frequency electronic pulses through coil cables. These signals create an oscillating electromagnetic field preventing mineral crystallization and scale formation throughout the pipe system.
about.tech4Text: Catalytic conversion transforms remaining hardness minerals into stable, harmless micro-crystals of 2–4 micron size. These crystals remain suspended in water and flow freely. The conditioning effect lasts up to 7 days.
about.microText: The entire Jaldoot system is controlled by an advanced microprocessor that automatically manages and optimizes all four technologies — Ultrasonic, Magnetic Static, Pulsing Power and Catalytic — ensuring consistent, reliable performance across all water conditions and flow rates.
